summary.headline: CRDO/MRVL/LRCX persisting-to-escalating RED on the AI-capex-anxiety selloff (CRDO -24% and MRVL -32% over the past month, both direct thesis-risk hits); LRCX re-escalated to RED after a June 30 downgrade. Broad AI-infrastructure and crypto sympathy weakness (AMD/ADI/KEYS/NXPI/TSM/QCOM, HOOD/HUT/MARA) 2 days ahead of MSFT/META earnings (7/29) and AAPL/AMZN (7/30) — the hyperscaler capex print the desk has been watching. flags.headline: CRDO -9.73% Friday session; -24% over 6 sessions, -18.7% over the month
flags.detail: Credo Technology fell $236.51→$213.49 (-9.73%) in the latest session, extending a 6-day losing streak that has erased ~$12B in market value (-23.7% cumulative), now well off its $308.67 52-week high. Trigger is the broader AI-infrastructure capex-anxiety rotation (Meta's July 1 'Meta Compute' surplus-capacity announcement reframed hyperscaler demand assumptions), not a CRDO-specific event. Trailing P/E of ~81 leaves no room for a guidance miss. Analysts remain bullish despite the move: Barclays raised its price target to $300 from $260 on 7/20 with a fresh Buy rating on 7/22.
flags.thesis_link: Matches CRDO key_risk #1: 'Extreme valuation — 109x trailing P/E ... embed aggressive growth expectations, leaving minimal margin of safety for any execution miss or AI capex slowdown.' The capex-anxiety rotation is that risk materializing in price, ahead of confirming/denying hyperscaler earnings this week.

evidence.source: MarketBeat — Credo Technology Group (NASDAQ:CRDO) Stock Price Down 7.3%
Trefis — A 6-Day Losing Streak Has Credo Technology Stock Down 24%

flags.headline: MRVL -7.11% Friday session; -32% over the past month
flags.detail: Marvell fell $209.39→$194.51 (-7.11%), extending a slide from its $316.43 all-time closing high (6/4) to roughly -39% off highs. Driven by revised hyperscaler capex forecasts and reports that Amazon may have shifted next-gen Trainium design work away from Marvell, clouding the custom-silicon narrative even as the design-win pipeline is reported intact. Same macro trigger as CRDO (AI-capex-anxiety rotation post 'Meta Compute').
flags.thesis_link: Matches MRVL key_risk #1 ('any miss against the $16.5B FY2028 revenue target or moderation in hyperscaler AI capex would trigger severe multiple compression') and key_risk #2 (hyperscaler customer concentration / in-house chip design shift) — the Amazon Trainium report is a direct hit on risk #2.

evidence.source: GuruFocus — Marvell Technology Inc (MRVL) Shares Fall 7.2%
The Motley Fool — Marvell Technology: The Stock Is Down 39% From Its High

flags.headline: LRCX -4.48% Friday session; -20.4% over the month — re-escalated after 6/30 downgrade
flags.detail: Lam Research fell $319.76→$305.42 (-4.48%), part of a broader semiconductor-equipment selloff on concerns AI chip demand is plateauing and sector overcapacity risk. This name was downgraded RED→AMBER on 2026-06-30 as the prior rout cooled; it has since resumed declining (-10.2% on 7/2, -5.28% on 7/13, -4.6% on 7/24) for a cumulative -20.4% monthly loss, warranting re-escalation to RED.
flags.thesis_link: Matches LRCX key_risk #1 ('any deceleration in AI infrastructure spending ... could trigger significant multiple compression') and key_risk #3 (semiconductor equipment cyclicality reversing from the current AI super-cycle).

evidence.source: GuruFocus — Lam Research Corp (LRCX) Shares Fall 4.6%
Yahoo Finance — Lam Research (LRCX) Stock Falls As AI Demand Fears Clash With Company Guidance

flags.headline: SSNC +10.33% — Q2 beat and raised FY26 guidance; AI-disruption risk converting to tailwind
flags.detail: Q2 2026 revenue grew 10.3% YoY to $1.70B (vs. $1.66B est.), adjusted EPS $1.76 (vs. $1.68 est.), on 7.6% organic growth. Management raised full-year revenue and EPS guidance. New deals with Marsh and Allspring deepen SS&C's AI-automation positioning. Q3 revenue guide came in slightly light, a minor offsetting note.
flags.thesis_link: Directly matches SSNC key_catalyst: 'Agentic AI deployment through the Link platform converting the AI narrative from headwind to tailwind' — this print is that catalyst materializing, and it cuts against key_risk #1 (AI-disruption narrative).

evidence.source: StockStory — SS&C (SSNC) Shares Skyrocket, What You Need To Know
